{{Quote|You will report to Major Harvin Franchels for more on the terrorist situation. He will let you know what you can do to help.|[[Pooja Naberrie/Legends|Pooja Naberrie]], to a trooper|<ref name="SWG:RtMF" />}}
'''Harvin Franchels''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and a [[Major/Legends|Major]] in the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Security Force]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:RtMF" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> he was the RSF officer in charge of the situation during the [[Terrorist attack in Theed|terrorist attack]] in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. Even after the initial attack, many terrorists remain in the part of the city that suffered the attack. Major Franchels tasked his agents to eliminate the remaining terrorists, disarm the bombs placed in the streets and deliver medical supplies to use on victims of the terrorist attack. After the situation was fixed, he transferred his agents to [[RSF Intelligence Division|RSF Intelligence]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Mercious Bragg|Bragg]]<ref name="SWG:HwtAotTA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Help with the Aftermath of the Terrorist Attack|Naboo}}</ref> to investigate the [[Mummers|identity]] of the culprits.<ref name="SWG:TtCotFMCG">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Tap the Communications of the Four Major Criminal Groups|Naboo}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Harvin Franchels appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RtMF" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Harvin Franchels was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
